text:
Priya (PM): Quick thread to finalize DP recruitment channels + onboarding rubric. Need short answers so we can lock the playbook by EOD.
Sam K: We should push 3 channels: targeted outreach to existing accounts, community post in our forum, and 1 outreach wave via partner network (consulting partners).
Maria P: Agree. Add a small cold list of 50 leads filtered by infra fit (uses GPUs, LLM experiments). But mark them as low-priority.
Eli (Growth): For conversion, include a short case blurb in the email: "Join as a design partner and shape Private's VPC UX + get infrastructure credits". A/B test two subject lines.
Priya (PM): Good call. How about onboarding rubric — what fields do we require in intake? Keep to essentials.
Jonah L: Intake required: company, contact, role, stack, primary use-case, expected QPS, data sensitivity (low/med/high), desired outcome, beta type (Dedicated/Private).
Maria P: Add a "success definition" free-text field: what success looks like for them (e.g., reduce latency by 30%, integrate with SSO). We use that to prioritize scope.
Nora S (Legal): Consent + NDA must be explicit. Suggest: short checkbox + link to NDA PDF, and a one-sentence data treatment statement: "Redwood will not use customer data for model training without explicit opt-in." Also flag any PII-heavy partners for escalation.
Sam K: Operationally, onboarding packet should include: single-page architecture diagram, temp creds, example requests, expected quota, rollback procedures. Make it one doc for quick read.
Eli (Growth): Recruitment messaging: 3-line email + 1 CTA (schedule or async). Provide a short testimonial from a previous DP if allowed. Conversion lift is huge.
Priya (PM): Compensation options: credits, Dedicated trial, or feature development priority. Which should be primary?
Maria P: Credits first, trial second, dev-time only for strategic partners. Keep structure consistent in outreach.
Jonah L: Scoring rubric for selection (we need weights): product-fit 40%, technical feasibility 25%, strategic delta 20%, legal/sensitivity overhead - penalty up to 20%. Also prefer partners with measurable success metrics.
Priya (PM): Can we capture baseline metrics during intake? e.g., current latency, model size, throughput. That helps measure impact.
Sam K: Yes. Add simple numeric fields: avg latency (ms), tokens/day, peak QPS. Optional but recommended.
Eli (Growth): For outreach pipeline, track lifecycle stage in a sheet: contacted, interested, scheduled, onboarded, active-feedback, retained. Use tags to surface at-risk partners.
Maria P: Retention incentives: early renewal discount, credits for referrals, or post-pilot case study opportunity. Which sounds clean?
Jonah L: Case study + credits works. Avoid promising long-term discounts before legal signs off.
Nora S (Legal): Case study requires a separate consent box. Also keep any case wording reviewable.
Priya (PM): Telemetry plan: we need events to signal activation and value. Minimal set:
```
- dp_onboarded (partner_id, start_ts)
- dp_key_used (partner_id, endpoint, tokens)
- dp_feedback_submitted (partner_id, category, severity)
- dp_success_metric_update (partner_id, metric_name, before, after)
```
That should be sent to internal analytics and grouped into a DP dashboard.
Sam K: Add heartbeat pings when partners hit the test endpoint. Helps detect stale creds/issues.
Eli (Growth): How about feedback cadence? Recommend checkpoints at week 1, week 3, and week 6 + optional weekly office hours. Keep each sync focused (tickets, blockers, wins).
Maria P: Also run a short qualitative interview at mid-pilot to capture narrative details. Script of 8 questions max.
Priya (PM): Launch / graduation criteria for DP cohort:
- Minimum 6 partners live and reporting feedback
- >=70% onboarding completion within 14 days
- At least 10 distinct actionable issues surfaced across cohort
- One partner willing to be a reference/case (opt-in)
- No critical security blockers unresolved
If met, we call the cohort a success and open for broader pilot.
Nora S (Legal): Add a gating item: security review for any partner with 'high' data sensitivity must be closed before onboarding.
Jonah L: Internal resourcing: recommend 1 PM + 1 SE per 3 partners + dedicated SRE on-call rotation for infra issues.
Sam K: Ops to prepare a sandbox with short-lived credentials and rate-limits per partner. Also a rollback checklist in case of regressions.
Eli (Growth): Timeline: 2-week recruitment window, 2-week onboarding sprint, 6-week pilot, 1-week analysis & grad. Total ~11 weeks from open to grad.
Maria P: Communication plan post-grad: send summary report and offer next steps (discounts, dedicated trial, enterprise outreach).
Priya (PM): Next steps: I'll assemble the intake form + scoring sheet and draft the outreach A/B. Eli will prepare email variants. Nora will review legal copy. Jonah will sketch telemetry events in analytics. Reconvene Wednesday 9:00 PT to approve final copy.
